summaries.summary: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have pledged not to call for a protest at Jantar Mantar until certain conditions are met, following their summons by the Delhi Police.
Tesla announced it will begin selling its new Cybercab vehicle, a unique autonomous design without traditional controls, by the end of the year despite ongoing safety investigations.
Bose has acquired audio rival Skullcandy in a strategic move to expand its market reach within the audio industry.
An attack at King Fahd Airport in Saudi Arabia has left one person dead and eight injured, leading to the diversion of several flights.
During upcoming talks, Indian PM Narendra Modi and Polish PM Donald Tusk will focus on trade and defense issues, especially relating to the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
A controversy over the removal of protest photographs by Priyanka Gandhi's son from an exhibition has sparked significant backlash, with criticisms surrounding censorship in the arts.
Airbnb's recent changes, including limiting cleaning chores required by hosts, have caused backlash, leading to concerns among hosts about the new expectations for guests.
Meta's new AI app, Muse, has surpassed 10 million users, with shopping being highlighted as one of the main uses.
Xbox has introduced a pay-as-you-go option for cloud gaming, allowing users to access games at a rate of $3.99 for 10 hours.
YouTube's decision to hide the dislike button on normal videos has led to user backlash and debates over content engagement.
